message: 内緒の同胞

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much, Mr. Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you want?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, you see, I have some huge news to share!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Agh!! You're thinking it's no big deal again, aren't you?! Maybe that's usually true, but today is on a whole different level!!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, you see... I ran into Amyrina.」

name: Azel
message: 「One of your brethren?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, my childhood friend. I spotted her today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「According to rumor, she came to the Human World a little while ago and has been searching for me the entire time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina stubbornly refused to ever come to the Human World. Why do you think she changed her mind?」

name: Azel
message: 「I wouldn't know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There has to be some kind of reason! Because... you know about it too, don't you, Mr. Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「The danger of shifting from spiritual matter to physical matter」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That might have some kind of harmful effect on her body, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「You're already well aware of that yourself, aren't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course I am! I know that a hundred times over.」

name: Azel
message: 「Then take Amyrina and return home together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why do you keep saying things like that?!」

name: Azel
message: 「By ceasing to be spiritual matter, you will never be able to return to Heaven.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you fine with that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I... already know that.」

name: Azel
message: 「Spirit becomes blood, and becomes flesh. Do you intend to bury your bones in this world?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been prepared for that ever since I came here. But Amyrina...」

name: Azel
message: 「It means Amyrina has made that same resolve」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way...!?」

name: Azel
message: 「However, her goal is different from yours. Rather than broadening her horizons, she's been relentlessly searching for you」

name: Azel
message: 「Disregarding her own safety, she stepped foot into the Human World. You don't need me to tell you why」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be that Amyrina did it for my sake...?」

name: Azel
message: 「I wouldn't know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After lecturing me that much, that's just unfair!!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm leaving」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hey, I said wait a second~~」
